visualCharacteristics.layout: 16:9 poster image with a centred play button and a caption below (title + '(c) Continental AG'). Clicking replaces the poster in place with the Continental (AdmiralCloud) player iframe; nothing third-party loads before the click. Fills its column (e.g. the third column of a 'three-column' section)

contentPattern: Poster image + link to https://video.continental.com/?v={uuid} + optional caption paragraph(s), in any rows/cells (one cell or one row per item both work). Poster from images.admiralcloud.com/v5/deliverEmbed/{uuid}/image/{width}, downloaded at import. The caption's first non-copyright line is the iframe title. A link that is not a video.continental.com URL keeps the poster as a plain link. Shared helper: /scripts/video-embed.js
